This template file is intended to be used for most documentation created in this course. It can be used to create friendly format for docx. 

You can use 

```yaml

#Automatically generates a table of contents 
#You can also choose the depth at which the ToC generates
# Based on the h1, h2, h3, so on. 
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
number-sections: true
```
